regime_context: Hong Kong’s detector shows a narrowing eligible set (5 of 17 themes) with Diversified Miners as the raw-momentum leader but gate-ineligible, while Tech Hardware & Semis is the eligible headline challenger. The only ETF-scorable themes are China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps (both 3033.HK), and both are gate-ineligible; aside from the single avoid below, I have no checkable overweight/underweight call.
emerging_watch: Tech Hardware & Semis may be forming as the eligible leadership: the raw-momentum leader Diversified Miners is gate-ineligible, and Tech Hardware & Semis is the challenger. I am watching for Tech Hardware & Semis to become rotation leader while remaining gate-eligible; if that occurs, the leadership handoff is confirmed and this watch closes.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only practical ETF-scorable theme in this scan (3033.HK) and sits on the wrong side of the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false), with negative momentum score, weak durability, and breadth below half. The one validated detector leg is drawdown/shake-out control via the trend gate, so the lean is to avoid exposure while the gate is off side; this is not treated as a return forecast.
theses.dissent: China Tech/Internet is high-beta and can re-rate sharply on policy support or AI sentiment; gate-ineligible does not imply negative forward return, so this avoid is a capital-preservation stance rather than a bear call.
